exposure: Degree of nerve preservation during parametrectomy (Excellent/P1, Regular/P2, Poor/P3)
cohort: Women undergoing laparoscopic and robotic nerve-sparing deep endometriosis (DE) surgeries were included in the study.
finding: Parametrectomy with poor-nerve preservation significantly increases the risk of urinary retention, including the need for prolonged intermittent self-catheterization, even if contralateral nerve preservation is excellent.
